name: cp2_october5_2026
eligibility: Every matched paid service with a Calendar start date in 5–27 October 2026; one source-linked immutable score within five minutes after scheduled end and before the first local outcome day. No backfill, outcome-based exclusions, model refit or threshold tuning.
prior_cohorts: Original, repaired and 1 October cloud cohorts remain separately recorded; this protocol does not repair their missing predictions.
known_operating_limit: A service ending after its local start date cannot meet the unchanged pre-outcome-day score rule. It remains an eligible missed case if no timely score exists; no silent exclusion is allowed.
acceptance: Complete source-derived outcomes and timely prediction for every eligible service; reject incomplete coverage. A completed result does not guarantee good accuracy.
